title: Protocol for quantitative evaluation of the impact of paracrine senescence on cellular reprogramming in cultured cells and mouse models
protocol: Seed HEK293T cells at 5 × 10^6 cells per P100 plate in MEF medium overnight.
Prepare a mix of 24 μL Fugene6 and 576 μL DMEM (total 600 μL) for each plasmid cocktail.
Incubate the mix at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 5 minutes.
Add 8 μg pBabe-ras and 8 μg pCLEco to one plasmid cocktail mix.
Combine 8 μg pBabe-PURO-EGFP and 8 μg pCLEco in another cocktail mix.
Incubate the DNA/Fugene6 mixes for 45 minutes at room temperature.
Add each DNA/Fugene6 mix dropwise to HEK293T cells without removing medium, distributing it around the plate.
Thaw one vial of primary MEFs and seed all onto a P100 plate in MEF medium.
Replace the medium for HEK293T cells with 10 mL fresh MEF medium.
Seed MEFs at 5 × 10^5 cells per P100 plate for infection using MEF medium.
Collect the medium from transfected HEK293T cells and replace with 10 mL of fresh MEF medium.
Centrifuge each collected medium separately at 2,000 g for 5 minutes at room temperature to remove cell debris.
Filter the supernatants separately through 0.45 μm filters.
Add Polybrene (8 μg/mL final concentration) to the filtered supernatants.
Repeat the infection one more time after 8–10 hours.
Remove the medium on Day 4 and refresh with 10 mL of MEF medium.
Trypsinize the cells from each plate on Day 5.
Reseed the cells at a density of 5 × 10^5 cells per P100 plate using MEF medium containing Puromycin (1 μg/mL).
Plate non-infected WT MEFs under the same conditions as the negative control for Puromycin selection.
Refresh the medium with MEF medium containing 1 μg/mL Puromycin on Day 7.
Remove the medium from the negative control plate and replace it with fresh conditioned MEF medium without Puromycin when no MEFs are visible, usually after 96 hours.
Collect the culture medium from senescent cells after two days in conditioned MEF medium.
Replenish fresh conditioned MEF medium for next rounds of collection.
Centrifuge the collected culture medium for 5 min at 500 g at room temperature.
Filter the supernatant with a 0.2 μm sterile filter.
Store the filtered medium in several aliquots at -20°C.
If separation of exosomes from soluble fraction is desired, centrifuge conditioned medium at 12,000 g for 30 min at 4°C and retain the supernatant while discarding the pellet.
Ultracentrifuge the supernatant at 100,000 g for 3 hours at 4°C.
Separate the supernatant from the pellet.
Store the soluble fraction at −20°C in aliquoted volumes.
Wash the exosomes by resuspending them in 1 mL PBS.
Ultracentrifuge the washed exosomes at 100,000 g for 3 hours at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after ultracentrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in 20–50 μL PBS.
Store the resuspended pellet at −20°C.
Seed i4F MEFs at a density of 5.2 × 10^2 cells/cm² (that is, 5.0 × 10³ cells per well of a 6-well plate) in MEF medium.
Remove MEF medium the following day.
Replace it with conditioned iPSC medium freshly supplemented with DOX at 1 μg/mL.
Change the conditioned iPSC medium supplemented with DOX every two days maximum.
Change the conditioned iPSC medium supplemented with DOX daily.
After 3 days, change the conditioned iPSC medium to normal iPSC medium supplemented with DOX (1 μg/mL).
Renew the medium every 2 days.
Remove the medium from the plates.
Wash the plate once with PBS at room temperature.
Fix cells with 4% PFA for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with PBS at room temperature, 5 minutes per wash.
Mix equal volumes of BCIP and NBT solutions.
Add the mixed staining solution sufficient to cover the plate, such as 0.5 ml for one well of a 6-well plate.
Place the plates on a shaker at room temperature protected from light.
Agitate mildly to ensure the staining solution covers the plate.
Inject cardiotoxin into tibialis anterior muscle of mice 10 days prior to sample collection.
Place a small amount of tragacanth gum on a slice of cork.
Extract both TA muscles.
Insert the distal tendon of the TA muscle (1/4 part) into the tragacanth gum and freeze directly in liquid nitrogen cooled isopentane for 40 seconds.
Generate 10 μm cryosections from TA muscle samples.
Allow evaporation of tissue freezing medium for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Fix the sections for 15 min in SA-β-Gal staining fixation buffer at room temperature.
Wash the slides three times with PBS, each wash lasting less than one minute.
Incubate the slides in the SA-β-Gal staining buffer at 37°C protected from light for 48 hours.
Check the slices using an inverted cell culture microscope (OLYMPUS CKX41).
Once the blue color is visible, quickly wash the slices three times with PBS.
Quickly wash the slices three times with PBS.
Put the slides in 4% PFA in PBS for post-fixation for 15 min at room temperature.
Critical: Post-fixation cannot be longer than 15 min.
Wash the slides three times with PBS.
Place the slides in a humid dark chamber.
Add 200 μl blocking buffer to every circle on the slides and incubate for at least 30 min at room temperature.
Remove the blocking buffer carefully.
Prepare Nanog 1st antibody at 1:200 in blocking buffer.
For experimental sections, add 200 μl 1st antibody to every circle of all the slides.
For control sections, add 200 μl blocking buffer.
Incubate the slides overnight at 4°C in a humid dark chamber.
Put the humid dark chamber at room temperature for 20–30 minutes.
Wash with PBST three times for 5 minutes each.
Add 3% H2O2 in PBS and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add second antibody directly and incubate for 90 minutes at room temperature in the humid dark chamber.
Prepare DAB solution according to manufacturer’s instructions, protecting it from light.
Wash with PBST three times for 5 minutes each.
Develop with DAB for 1 minute at room temperature.
Quickly wash slides in Milli-Q water three times.
Counterstain with Fast-red for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash slides in tap water for 10 minutes.
Dehydrate slides in 95% ethanol for 10 minutes, followed by two baths of 100% ethanol for 5 minutes each.
Mount slides with Eukitt following manufacturer’s recommendations.
Evaporate slides in the hood overnight.
Scan the slides using a scanning microscope OLYMPUS vs120.
Install Anaconda on your computer.
Install PyCharm (community version, optional) on your computer.
Install opencv-python using pip in the Terminal or Anaconda Prompt.
Install numpy using conda in the Terminal or Anaconda Prompt.
Download Showblue from https://github.com/CroixJeremy2/Showblue.
Decompress the downloaded .zip folder.
Modify the content of “start_environment.bat” on Windows to include the path to Anaconda, for example: "%windir%\System32\cmd.exe"/K" D:\programs\anaconda\Scripts\activate.bat D:\programs\anaconda".
Crop a part of the image next to the edge and save three copies named “file1.jpg”, “file2.jpg”, and “t1.jpg” respectively in the folder named “cfg_fig6”.
Label the “blank area” by drawing black scribbles outside of the muscle section via an image editor software on “file1.jpg” and save it as “file1_bk.jpg” in the “cfg_fig6” folder.
Label the “inside area” by drawing black scribbles inside the muscle section on “file2.jpg” and save it as “file2_inside.jpg”.
Label SA-β-Gal+ cells by drawing white dots on top of them on “t1.jpg” and save it as “t1_pt.jpg”.
Pre-run Showblue to set up automatically the parameters.
Open Terminal on macOS and run show_all_fig_para.sh script.
On Windows, double click start_envrionment.bat file.
Drag show_all_windows_fig_para.bat into the opened window and press enter.
Check quantification results in the “process” folder.
Configure Showblue settings manually if automatic settings are not satisfactory.
Locate text parameters in the folder named "cfg".
Adjust the sensitivity of tissue boundary detection by modifying the alpha value in cfg_alpha.txt.
Set or adjust the mean color value ± standard deviations for points outside the tissue boundary described in cfg_bk.txt.
Copy and paste all images that need to be quantified into the “showblue-main” folder.
Run Showblue by opening a terminal in the “showblue-main” folder on macOS.
Drag the file named show_all_fig_para.sh into the Terminal and press enter.
On Windows, double click on the start_environment.bat file.
Drag the show_all_windows_para.bat file into the opened window and press enter.
Let the computer work automatically.
Check all quantification results in the “process” folder as described in step_52.
Import the “data.txt” file into a spreadsheet for further analysis.
Calculate the results using the equation: S A − β − G a l + c e l l s / u n i t a r e a = [ c o u n t e d p o i n t s ] / [ p i x e l a r e a ] × 10 6
